nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Environment variable template listing all required secrets and service URLs (LiteLLM, database, Redis, Clerk auth, MinIO storage, port and CORS settings) with placeholder values safe to commit.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents 12 required env vars across 5 subsystems: LLM routing, database, auth (Clerk), server, and object storage (MinIO).

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Authoritative operating contract for all contributors and AI agents, covering project architecture, repository structure, behavioral coding rules, persona architecture, security constraints, and sprint status with 11 numbered sections and 42 sub-headings.
nodes.languageNotes: Acts as the canonical specification driving all AI agent behavior in the monorepo; referenced by every coding session as the single source of truth.

nodes.name: EVAL-RESULTS-V5.md
nodes.summary: Detailed PromptAssembler v5 evaluation results across 4 hypotheses and multiple model conditions (Gemma 4 31B, Gemma 4 26B MoE, Qwen3-30B), including judge ensemble analysis, variance-retry statistics, and honest observations concluding H1 replicates but the small-model thesis is invalid.

nodes.name: EVAL-RESULTS.md
nodes.summary: Initial PromptAssembler evaluation results comparing baseline vs PA-conditioned outputs across frontier and small models, with per-scenario breakdowns, sample outputs for 6 scenarios, and nuanced analysis of why PA hurt Gemma 31B specifically.

nodes.name: PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Executed plan for the Waggle OS habit-forming UX refactor covering pre-refactor audit, target experience, phased implementation (P0–P7 all shipped to main at d369f6a), a 3-round judge loop run on 2026-06-12, and boundaries honored.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview for Waggle OS with architecture description, quick-start setup instructions, environment variable reference, and license information across 5 sections.

nodes.name: litellm-config.yaml
nodes.summary: LiteLLM router configuration listing the full model catalog available to the Waggle agent runtime, defining model aliases, provider routing, and global LiteLLM settings across 498 lines.
nodes.languageNotes: Covers both cloud providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and local model endpoints; model_list defines aliases used by the agent cost tracker and persona model preferences.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Root npm workspace manifest declaring all 27 workspace packages under apps/* and packages/*, root-level dev/runtime dependencies, and the full suite of build, test, lint, and deploy scripts for the monorepo.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses npm workspaces with bun.lock co-present; defines scripts like build:packages (ordered tsc build: shared→core→agent→server) and test:all for the full Playwright suite.

nodes.name: render.yaml
nodes.summary: Render.com deployment manifest defining web service(s) and a managed PostgreSQL database for the waggle-os cloud deployment, covering build commands, environment variables, and health check configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: Provisions a Render web service plus a managed database; ties the sidecar build and serve commands to the cloud environment.

nodes.name: tsconfig.base.json
nodes.summary: Base TypeScript compiler configuration shared across all monorepo packages, defining common compilerOptions (strict mode, module resolution, target ES version, path aliases).
nodes.languageNotes: Extended by per-package tsconfig files; centralizes strict/ES target/moduleResolution settings to ensure consistency across 27 workspaces.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript project configuration that extends tsconfig.base.json and references the monorepo workspace packages for composite build orchestration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses TypeScript project references (composite mode) enabling incremental builds across the full package dependency chain.
